programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.desc: Drug trafficking has spawned a violent and deadly criminal underground. It's providing a challenge to forensic investigators devoted to cracking drug rings.

programme.title: The New Detectives

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Arson Investigation: Insurance torchings, mob burnouts and arson murders: these crimes are designed to take all clues with them. But a solid case can be built from a heap of ashes.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: DNA Analysis: With the advent of DNA analysis, just a few microscopic cells found at a crime scene can be used to put a murder behind bars.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For some killers, murder can be a profitable business. And the scene of the crime can be both a source for clues, and puzzling questions. When a victim has been targeted for death, investigators must look beyond the obvious to uncover a murder for hire.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: For a price, anything's possible. Contract killings arose out of the need to establish the perfect alibi. By hiring someone else to do the dirty work, a person can deflect guilt, at least in theory.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: The Great Outdoors may offer great clues to solving brutal murders. But it takes the keen eye of the forensic entomologist and botanist to decipher the clues nature provides.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Missing Person: Approximately 1.8 million Americans are reported missing each year. Worldwide, the number of missing persons nearly triples.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Terrorism: Thanks to new technology and, perhaps, the approaching millennium, terrorism is a growing international threat. The Oklahoma City explosion and the bombing of the World Trade Center are just two of the incidents of this growing problem.

programme.title: The New Detectives
programme.desc: Sometimes the scales of justice are balanced by just a few milligrams of evidence – a couple of fibers, a tooth filling, or a smudge on a piece of tape. The biggest cases are often solved by the smallest clues.

programme.title: The New Option
programme.desc: An elite cop fulfils his dream to join the Special Duty Unit. Now, he faces rigorous training and the challenge of stopping a daring heist by a gang of dangerous criminals.

programme.title: The Postman Fights Back
programme.desc: When postman Ma and three other mismatched allies deliver a secret cargo to the rebel leader, Ma finds himself on a patriotic quest to save the country and himself.

programme.title: 3AM The Driver
programme.desc: A taxi driver who judges others by his own standards sets out to help 'victims' in his own way. When a woman he likes seems to be bullied by her son, he tries to help her.

programme.title: The Flag Of Iron
programme.desc: Deadly deception and betrayal unfolds when the leader of the respectable iron flag clan is assassinated.

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: Guo Jing falls in love with Huang, but Ouyang also wants to marry her. Huang's father sets a duel to decide her fate. Guo must defeat Ouyang to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: Ip Man
programme.desc: Set during the Sino-Japanese War, Wing Chun grandmaster Ip Man is forced to leave home and work to support his family by teaching martial arts skills for self-defense.

programme.title: Duel Of Fist
programme.desc: David Chiang & Ti Lung star as 2 skilled boxers in this martial arts masterpiece of gambling and revenge from the legendary Chang Cheh.

programme.title: Shaolin Martial Arts
programme.desc: The Manchu Emperor employs some top boxers to destroy Shaolin Temple. Almost all the Shaolin disciples were killed, but the survivors now band together to seek revenge.

programme.title: Butterfly Lovers
programme.desc: Loosely based on the Butterfly Lovers legend, this is the tragic love story between Zhu Yan Zhi and her martial arts senior, Liang Zhong Shan.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: After Detective Hei's father-in-law is murdered, his wife enlists the help of private detective Bong to uncover the truth, which may be linked to Hei.

programme.title: The Avenging Fist
programme.desc: A young man uses the martial arts skill created by his father, and the Power Glove, a tool that unleashes mind power, to battle rebels who intend to dominate the world.

programme.title: Ten Tigers Of Kwangtung
programme.desc: Anti-Ch'ing revolutionary leader, Chai Min Yu, is being hunted down by Manchu General Liang. He is almost caught when a masked man rescues him from death and escapes with him.

programme.title: Come Drink With Me
programme.desc: Bandits kidnap the governor's son. The governor's daughter, a skilled martial artist, is sent to rescue him, but soon finds herself in need of assistance.

programme.title: Night Walk
programme.desc: Frank is framed for murder. He is sent to a prison where he meets a Muslim inmate who helps him plan for a prison escape to prove his innocence. Can he succeed finally?

programme.title: Return of the One-armed Swordsman
programme.desc: Director Chang Cheh mounting a follow-up which many say is even more accomplishing and exciting than the original.

programme.title: Tiger Cage
programme.desc: A team of police officers uncover their seniors' involvement in an illegal plot after a drug operation raid. They vow to bring them to justice and root out corruption.

programme.title: Na Cha the Great
programme.desc: Rebellious Na Cha kills the Dragon King's son, sparking divine wrath. After a sacrifice, he is reborn more powerful than ever and rises to fight for justice.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A triad boss colludes with officials to become mayor. His right-hand man commits crimes to fund his rise. Just as victory nears, their dynamic takes an unexpected turn.

programme.title: Warriors Two
programme.desc: Fatty helps his friend Wah to learn martial arts from his Wing Chun master, so that Wah can take down the villains and avenge his mother's death.

programme.title: Whampoa Blues
programme.desc: Cong and Jin are students of the Whampoa Military Training School. While there, they accidentally discover an ammunition smuggling plan, putting their lives in danger.

programme.title: Brave Archer And His Mate
programme.desc: The lead character is out to defeat a mass martial arts murderer with the help of his fellow brave archers.

programme.title: Hero
programme.desc: When two brothers escape poverty to make their fortune in Shanghai, they befriend a powerful mobster and end up battling rival gangs.

programme.title: One-Armed Swordsman
programme.desc: A noble swordsman, whose arm had been chopped off, returns to his former teacher to defend him from a villainous gang of rival swordsmen.

programme.title: The Proud Twins
programme.desc: A bitter princess kills a man and his mistress and separates their twin babies. One is raised by villains, and the other is raised by her to unknowingly kill his own brother.

programme.title: The Black Lizard
programme.desc: A newly-married man leaves on a three-year mission to deliver something to the capital. Two years later, a mysterious figure appears and tells him to head home.

programme.title: The 14 Amazons
programme.desc: The Yang family had served their country in Song Dynasty for generations. General Yang is ambushed and killed during the war in Jin Shan.

programme.title: 3AM The Office
programme.desc: A newcomer offends the ghosts in his office on his first day at work and experiences spooky encounters during night shifts, making him reflect on his behaviour.

programme.title: Crippled Avengers
programme.desc: Three men, crippled by an evil warlord, become friends and learn kung fu with the help of an old teacher and his idiot pupil.

programme.title: Two Champions Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Two young warriors from the rebel Shaolin Clan are engaged in a deadly secret mission that could bring down the empire.

programme.title: The Magnificent Butcher
programme.desc: In this classic martial arts comedy, Sammo Hung stars as Lam Sai Wing, the disciple of Wong Fei Hung, who gets embroiled in a feud with a rival kung fu school.

programme.title: Nezha
programme.desc: A former top team racing driver wants to prove himself in a race but accidentally hurts his teammate Lily. A talented virtual car racing champion joins them to regain its glory.
